summary: Gildan Activewear Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, reporting voting results from its annual meeting of shareholders held on April 30, 2026. The meeting covered standard items: election of nine directors, reappointment of auditor, approval of a Shareholder Rights Plan, and a non-binding Say on Pay vote. All resolutions passed with strong shareholder support. This is a routine foreign private issuer report disclosing ordinary meeting outcomes, not a special situation. No event triggering special-situations classification occurred.
